+基于 CANN 基础镜像的源码安装
+============================================================
+
+Last updated: 11/03/2026.
+
+本文提供 ARM64、A3、Ubuntu 22.04 环境下的安装入口：先准备包含 CANN 和
+NNAL/ATB 的基础容器，再按照 :doc:`昇腾安装指南 <install_guidance>` 的
+“源码安装”章节安装 verl 和所选后端。基础镜像尚未安装完整的 verl 训推环境。
+如果希望直接使用已安装好框架的镜像，请参考
+:doc:`昇腾镜像说明 <dockerfile_build_guidance>`。
+
+1. 检查宿主机
+-------------
+
+宿主机需要 Docker，以及与所选 CANN 版本、A3 硬件匹配的驱动和固件。
+驱动安装及版本要求见 :doc:`昇腾安装指南 <install_guidance>`。
+在宿主机执行：
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+
+   uname -m
+   npu-smi info
+   docker version
+
+确认架构为 ``aarch64``、设备健康状态为 ``OK``，并取得要使用的设备的使用权限。
+后面的 Quick Start 示例默认使用八个逻辑设备；A3 设备应成对分配。
+
+2. 按推理后端选择基础镜像
+------------------------------------------------------------
+
+只执行所选后端对应的一组命令。同一后端的 FSDP2 和 Megatron 使用相同的基础镜像。
+
+**vLLM：**
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+   :name: container-image-vllm
+
+   export IMAGE=swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/cann:9.1.0-a3-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
+   docker pull "$IMAGE"
+
+**SGLang：**
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+   :name: container-image-sglang
+
+   export IMAGE=swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/cann:8.5.0-a3-ubuntu22.04-py3.11
+   docker pull "$IMAGE"
+
+这两组镜像标签也是文档安装 CI 的配置来源。修改镜像时，应同时核对原安装指南中的
+依赖版本及对应的安装脚本。
+
+3. 启动容器
+-----------
+
+以下示例使用宿主机的逻辑设备 0–7。根据已分配给你的设备调整全部
+``--device /dev/davinciN`` 参数；驱动和 ``npu-smi`` 路径也应与宿主机一致。
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+
+   mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/verl-ascend"
+   docker run --rm -it \
+       --name verl-source-install \
+       --shm-size=16g \
+       --device /dev/davinci0 \
+       --device /dev/davinci1 \
+       --device /dev/davinci2 \
+       --device /dev/davinci3 \
+       --device /dev/davinci4 \
+       --device /dev/davinci5 \
+       --device /dev/davinci6 \
+       --device /dev/davinci7 \
+       --device /dev/davinci_manager \
+       --device /dev/devmm_svm \
+       --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
+       -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \
+       -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \
+       -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \
+       -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info:ro \
+       -v "$HOME/.cache/verl-ascend:/root/.cache" \
+       --workdir /workspace \
+       "$IMAGE" bash
+
+``--rm`` 会在退出后删除容器及其中安装的环境；模型和数据缓存保留在宿主机挂载目录。
+需要保留安装环境时，去掉 ``--rm``，退出后可用 ``docker start -ai verl-source-install``
+重新进入。
+
+4. 在容器中准备系统依赖和 Conda
+------------------------------------------------------------
+
+后续命令均在容器内以 root 执行。先安装编译、下载工具：
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+   :name: container-prerequisites-ubuntu
+
+   apt-get update
+   apt-get install -y gcc g++ cmake libnuma-dev wget git curl unzip build-essential ca-certificates
+
+如果尚未安装 Conda，可安装最新版 Miniforge。安装目录需要是尚不存在的目录；
+已有 Conda 时，直接加载其 ``etc/profile.d/conda.sh`` 即可。
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+   :name: container-conda
+
+   curl -fL -o Miniforge3.sh \
+       "https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Miniforge3-$(uname)-$(uname -m).sh"
+   bash Miniforge3.sh -b -p "$HOME/miniforge3"
+   source "$HOME/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
+   conda --version
+
+下载方式见 `Miniforge 官方下载页 <https://conda-forge.org/download/>`_。
+若所在网络需要代理或组织 CA，请先配置相应网络环境和证书信任。
+
+确认容器内可以使用已安装的 CANN、ATB 和设备：
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+
+   source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
+   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
+   npu-smi info
+
+5. 执行源码安装和 Quick Start
+------------------------------------------------------------
+
+保持在容器的 ``/workspace`` 目录，根据所选镜像执行
+:doc:`昇腾安装指南 <install_guidance>` 中对应后端的完整“源码安装”代码块。
+这些命令会创建 Python 环境、下载 verl，并调用项目已有的安装脚本。
+容器已提供 CANN 和 ATB，无需再次执行宿主机驱动和 CANN 安装步骤。
+
+.. list-table:: 安装方式与运行入口
+   :header-rows: 1
+
+   * - 组合
+     - 源码安装章节
+     - 执行安装代码块前
+     - Quick Start 中的组合
+   * - FSDP2 + vLLM
+     - 自定义安装-vLLM + FSDP/Megatron
+     - ``export USE_MEGATRON=0``
+     - ``fsdp2_vllm``
+   * - Megatron + vLLM
+     - 自定义安装-vLLM + FSDP/Megatron
+     - ``export USE_MEGATRON=1``
+     - ``megatron_vllm``
+   * - FSDP2 + SGLang
+     - 自定义安装-SGLang + FSDP/Megatron
+     - ``export USE_MEGATRON=0``
+     - ``fsdp2_sglang``
+   * - Megatron + SGLang
+     - 自定义安装-SGLang + FSDP/Megatron
+     - ``export USE_MEGATRON=1``
+     - ``megatron_sglang``
+
+安装成功后进入 ``/workspace/verl``，保持对应 Conda 环境处于激活状态，按
+:doc:`昇腾快速上手说明 <quick_start>` 准备模型、处理 GSM8K 数据并运行所选组合。
+仅完成包安装或导入检查，还不能说明训练已经成功。
+
+文档安装测试的范围
+------------------
+
+文档安装 CI 从本文读取基础镜像及 Ubuntu 系统依赖命令，通过 setup-miniconda
+安装 Miniforge，再从原安装指南、Quick Start 提取安装和运行命令。
+CI 由 runner 提供设备和模型、数据缓存；手动运行时需要自行完成上述容器启动和输入准备。
+CI 安装的是当前 PR 待验证的提交，普通用户按指南克隆的是仓库默认分支。
+
+PR 工作流为表中的四种组合分别创建安装与单步 GRPO 验证任务，串行执行；
+手动触发可选择一种组合或全部组合。这里说明的是测试覆盖配置，是否通过以对应运行结果为准。
+该工作流不验证宿主机驱动安装、从零安装 CANN、A2/A5 或 openEuler。

+# Ascend documentation doctests
+
+These scripts extract existing commands from
+`docs/ascend_tutorial/zh/get_start/` and exercise verl's installation and GRPO
+Quick Start. Test-side selectors identify the installation code blocks and
+Quick Start table entries. The existing installation and Quick Start pages keep
+their layout; the new container guide uses standard RST code-block names for
+image selection and prerequisites. Missing or ambiguous commands fail the check.
+
+Read-only checks require Bash and Python 3.10 or newer, without an NPU:
+
+```bash
+bash tests/e2e/doctests/scripts/run_doctests.sh installation check
+DRY_RUN=1 bash tests/e2e/doctests/scripts/run_doctests.sh quickstart fsdp2_vllm
+```
+
+`installation check` validates all registered commands and the syntax
+of installation blocks. `DRY_RUN=1` checks the selected Quick Start blocks
+and training script without sourcing CANN, reading models, preprocessing
+data, or starting training. Set `DOCTEST_PYTHON` to select the interpreter
+used by the extraction tool when `python3` is unavailable locally.
+
+Real Quick Start runs require a compatible Ascend container, CANN/ATB,
+installed verl and backend packages, a local Qwen3-0.6B model, and GSM8K input:
+
+```bash
+MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3-0.6B GSM8K_DATASET_PATH=/path/to/gsm8k \
+  bash tests/e2e/doctests/scripts/run_doctests.sh quickstart fsdp2_vllm
+```
+
+Supported cases are `fsdp2_vllm`, `megatron_vllm`, `fsdp2_sglang`, and
+`megatron_sglang`. Each run defaults to one GRPO step and eight visible NPU
+devices; override `TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS` and `NDEVICES_PER_NODE` as needed.
+The worker runs the documented preprocessing command and uses its output
+directory (`GSM8K_OUTPUT_DIR`, default `$HOME/data/gsm8k`). To reuse existing
+parquet files, set **both** `TRAIN_FILE` and `TEST_FILE`; this skips preprocessing.
+
+Source installation requires a disposable Ubuntu/openEuler container with
+compatible drivers, CANN/ATB and Conda already installed. It installs system
+build tools, initializes Conda, creates a new environment, runs the documented
+installer, logs Python/package versions, checks imports, and executes the chosen
+Quick Start case. Version logging helps diagnose mismatches; it is not a strict
+comparison against the documentation's compatibility table.
+
+For the A3 Ubuntu environment used by CI, follow the public
+[CANN container source-install guide](../../../docs/ascend_tutorial/zh/get_start/container_source_install.rst).
+Its image assignments are the source of truth for CI, and the Ubuntu worker
+executes its system-dependency block. The guide explains how to start the
+container, prepare Conda, and continue with the existing installation commands.
+
+```bash
+ALLOW_INSTALL=1 INSTALL_BACKEND=sglang INSTALL_CASE=fsdp2_sglang \
+MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3-0.6B GSM8K_DATASET_PATH=/path/to/gsm8k \
+  bash tests/e2e/doctests/scripts/run_doctests.sh installation source
+```
+
+`INSTALL_BACKEND` defaults to `vllm`; `INSTALL_CASE` defaults to
+`fsdp2_<backend>` and must match that backend. It selects `USE_MEGATRON`
+for the installer. The checkout defaults to the current repository's **HEAD
+commit**, so uncommitted changes are not included in the cloned installation.
+Set `VERL_REPOSITORY`/`VERL_REVISION` to test another repository or commit.
+Quick Start itself uses the working checkout, including uncommitted changes.
+
+The harness isolates the documented named Conda environment under
+`INSTALL_WORKDIR/conda-envs` and redirects the documented verl clone to the
+repository/revision under test. `CANN_ENV_SCRIPT`, `ATB_ENV_SCRIPT`,
+`GSM8K_DATASET_PATH` and `GSM8K_OUTPUT_DIR` override local paths only during
+execution; plain `doctest_helper.py extract` returns the original commands.
+
+The automatically created temporary installation directory is deleted on exit.
+Set `KEEP_INSTALL_WORKDIR=1` to retain it, or provide an empty
+`INSTALL_WORKDIR` (which is always retained). Source installation also supports
+`ALLOW_INSTALL=1 DRY_RUN=1` to validate the plan without installing packages.
+
+The GitHub workflow runs CPU tool tests on relevant pull requests, followed by
+source installation and one GRPO step for **each of the four combinations** on
+the upstream project's A3 eight-device runner. Matrix jobs run one at a time;
+one failed case does not cancel the remaining cases. Fork pull requests follow the repository's workflow
+approval policy; a maintainer must approve runs when GitHub requires it.
+New runs on the same ref cancel older runs. Workflows running in forks execute
+only the CPU checks.
+
+Manual runs can select one combination or `all`. Configured coverage does not
+mean that every combination has already passed; inspect each job's result.
+Preview the exact image/case matrix without installing anything:
+
+```bash
+python3 tests/e2e/doctests/scripts/doctest_helper.py matrix
+python3 tests/e2e/doctests/scripts/doctest_helper.py matrix --case fsdp2_sglang
+```
+
+GitHub requires
+the workflow to exist on the default branch before `workflow_dispatch` is
+available; the pull-request trigger provides installation coverage before merge.
+The CANN base image comes from the selected backend's command in the public
+container guide; the workflow bootstraps Miniforge, while the original installation
+documentation creates the Python environment.
+The runner must expose its NPU devices and cached inputs to the container:
+Qwen3-0.6B under `/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` and GSM8K
+under `/root/.cache/modelscope/dataset/openai/gsm8k`, matching the existing

+The workflow sets `HF_DATASETS_CACHE=/tmp/verl-doctest/huggingface/datasets`
+inside the disposable container for Datasets lock files and Arrow processing
+cache. It checks the model config, dataset directory, and cache write access
+before installing packages. A2 and openEuler are not included in this workflow.
+
+```bash
+python3 -m pytest -q tests/special_sanity/test_doctest_helper.py
+```
+
+On Windows, the Bash integration tests can use Git Bash via `DOCTEST_TEST_BASH`.
+These CPU checks validate test orchestration; an actual installation/training
+run is still required on Ascend hardware.

+
+Test-side selectors keep installation guidance and Quick Start tables readable.

+
+QUICK_DOC = "docs/ascend_tutorial/zh/get_start/quick_start.rst"
+CONTAINER_DOC = "docs/ascend_tutorial/zh/get_start/container_source_install.rst"
+
+CASES = ("fsdp2_vllm", "megatron_vllm", "fsdp2_sglang", "megatron_sglang")
+
+BLOCKS_BY_FILE = {
+    CONTAINER_DOC: (
+        "container-image-vllm",
+        "container-image-sglang",
+        "container-prerequisites-ubuntu",
+        "container-conda",
+    ),
+    INSTALL_DOC: (
+        "installation-vllm",
+        "installation-sglang",
+    ),
+    QUICK_DOC: (
+        "quickstart-environment",
+        "quickstart-data",
+        *(f"quickstart-{case}" for case in CASES),
+    ),
+}
+
+FILE_BY_BLOCK = {name: path for path, names in BLOCKS_BY_FILE.items() for name in names}
+
+# Match executable lines, not comments or prose mentioning the same command.
+BLOCK_ANCHORS = {
+    "installation-vllm": r"^bash verl/scripts/install_vllm_mcore_npu\.sh(?:\s|$)",
+    "installation-sglang": r"^bash verl/scripts/install_sglang_mcore_npu\.sh(?:\s|$)",
+    "quickstart-environment": r"^source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env\.sh\s*$",
+    "quickstart-data": r"^python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k\.py(?:\s|$)",
+}
+
+DIRECTIVE_RE = re.compile(r"^( *)\.\. (?:code|code-block):: (bash|python)[ \t]*$")
+
+
+class DoctestError(ValueError):
+    """Missing, ambiguous or malformed documented commands."""
+
+
+def extract_rst_blocks(text, source="input", *, name=None):
+    """Read existing RST code directives without requiring documentation markers."""
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    blocks = []
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(lines):
+        opening = DIRECTIVE_RE.fullmatch(lines[index])
+        index += 1
+        if not opening:
+            continue
+        base_indent = len(opening[1])
+        block_name = None
+        while index < len(lines) and lines[index].lstrip().startswith(":"):
+            option = lines[index].strip()
+            if option.startswith(":name:"):
+                block_name = option.removeprefix(":name:").strip()
+            index += 1
+        if index >= len(lines) or lines[index].strip():
+            raise DoctestError(f"Missing blank line after directive in {source}")
+        while index < len(lines) and not lines[index].strip():
+            index += 1
+        if index >= len(lines):
+            raise DoctestError(f"Empty code block in {source}")
+        indent = len(lines[index]) - len(lines[index].lstrip(" "))
+        if indent <= base_indent:
+            raise DoctestError(f"Unindented code block in {source}")
+        body = []
+        while index < len(lines):
+            line = lines[index]
+            if line.strip():
+                line_indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
+                if line_indent <= base_indent:
+                    break
+                if line_indent < indent:
+                    raise DoctestError(f"Inconsistent code indentation in {source}")
+            body.append(line[indent:])
+            index += 1
+        if name is None or name == block_name:
+            blocks.append("\n".join(body).rstrip() + "\n")
+    return blocks
+
+
+def extract_doctest_block(text, name, source="input"):
+    """Select exactly one existing code block or Quick Start table command."""
+    if name in BLOCKS_BY_FILE[CONTAINER_DOC]:
+        matches = extract_rst_blocks(text, source, name=name)
+    elif name in BLOCK_ANCHORS:
+        matches = [
+            block for block in extract_rst_blocks(text, source) if re.search(BLOCK_ANCHORS[name], block, re.MULTILINE)
+        ]
+    elif name.removeprefix("quickstart-") in CASES:
+        case = name.removeprefix("quickstart-")
+        script = re.escape(f"tests/special_npu/quick_start/run_qwen3_0_6b_{case}_ascend.sh")
+        matches = [
+            match + "\n"
+            for match in re.findall(rf"^[ \t]+- (bash {script}(?:[ \t]+[^\n]*)?)[ \t]*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
+        ]
+    else:
+        raise DoctestError(f"Unknown documentation block: {name}")
+    if len(matches) > 1:
+        raise DoctestError(f"Ambiguous documentation block {name!r} in {source}")
+    return matches[0] if matches else None
+
+
+def adapt_runtime_block(block, name):
+    """Substitute local CANN/data paths only; keep raw extraction unchanged."""
+    for path, variable in (
+        ("/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh", "CANN_ENV_SCRIPT"),
+        ("/usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh", "ATB_ENV_SCRIPT"),
+    ):
+        if value := os.environ.get(variable):
+            block = re.sub(
+                rf"^source {re.escape(path)}[ \t]*$",
+                lambda _: f"source {shlex.quote(value)}",
+                block,
+                flags=re.MULTILINE,
+            )
+    if name == "quickstart-data":
+        lines = block.splitlines()
+        for index, line in enumerate(lines):
+            if not re.match(BLOCK_ANCHORS[name], line):
+                continue
+            for option, variable in (
+                ("--local_dataset_path", "GSM8K_DATASET_PATH"),
+                ("--local_save_dir", "GSM8K_OUTPUT_DIR"),
+            ):
+                if value := os.environ.get(variable):
+                    argument = r"""(?:"[^"\n]*"|'[^'\n]*'|[^\s;]+)"""
+                    pattern = rf"({re.escape(option)}[ \t]+){argument}"

+"""Check verl Ascend doctest prerequisites without launching training."""
+
+import argparse
+import importlib
+import sys
+from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def fail(message: str) -> None:
+    """Print one failure message to stderr."""
+    print(f"verify_runtime: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+
+def check_input_file(path_text: str, label: str) -> bool:
+    """Require each supplied input path to be a nonempty file."""
+    if not path_text:
+        return True
+    path = Path(path_text)
+    if not path.is_file():
+        fail(f"{label} not found: {path_text}")
+        return False
+    if path.stat().st_size == 0:
+        fail(f"{label} is empty: {path_text}")
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def check_model_dir(model_path: str) -> bool:
+    """Require a supplied model directory to contain config.json."""
+    if not model_path:
+        return True
+    if not Path(model_path, "config.json").is_file():
+        fail(f"model config.json not found under: {model_path}")
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def npu_device_count(failures: list[str]) -> int:
+    """Return the visible NPU count, recording import or device-query failures."""
+    try:
+        import torch
+
+        importlib.import_module("torch_npu")  # Register the NPU extension before querying devices.
+    except Exception as error:
+        message = f"cannot import torch/torch_npu for device check: {error}"
+        failures.append(message)
+        fail(message)
+        return -1
+    try:
+        return torch.npu.device_count()
+    except Exception as error:
+        message = f"cannot query NPU devices: {error}"
+        failures.append(message)
+        fail(message)
+        return -1
+
+
+def check_imports(backend: str = "") -> bool:
+    """Import core/backend packages and log their installed versions for diagnosis."""
+    print(f"Python: {sys.version.split()[0]}")
+    ok = True
+    modules = ["verl", "torch", "torch_npu"]
+    if backend == "vllm":
+        modules.extend(("vllm", "vllm_ascend"))
+    elif backend == "sglang":
+        modules.append("sglang")
+    for module in modules:
+        try:
+            imported = importlib.import_module(module)
+            try:
+                installed = version(module.replace("_", "-"))
+            except PackageNotFoundError:
+                installed = getattr(imported, "__version__", "unknown (no package metadata)")
+            print(f"{module}: {installed}")
+        except Exception as error:
+            fail(f"cannot import {module}: {error}")
+            ok = False
+    return ok
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse the optional runtime checks requested by the caller."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Verify verl Ascend doctest runtime prerequisites.")
+    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default="")
+    parser.add_argument("--train-file", default="")
+    parser.add_argument("--test-file", default="")
+    parser.add_argument("--min-devices", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--check-imports", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--backend", choices=("vllm", "sglang"), default="")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.min_devices < 0:
+        parser.error("--min-devices must be nonnegative")
+    if args.backend and not args.check_imports:
+        parser.error("--backend requires --check-imports")
+    return args
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    """Run the requested checks and return a nonzero status on any failure."""
+    args = parse_args()
+    ok = True
+    ok &= check_model_dir(args.model_path)
+    ok &= check_input_file(args.train_file, "train file")
+    ok &= check_input_file(args.test_file, "test file")
+    if args.check_imports:
+        ok &= check_imports(args.backend)
+    if args.min_devices > 0:
+        failures: list[str] = []
+        count = npu_device_count(failures)
+        if count >= 0 and count < args.min_devices:
+            message = f"requires at least {args.min_devices} NPU device(s), found {count}"
+            failures.append(message)
+            fail(message)
+        ok &= not failures
+    return 0 if ok else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
